comments.author: ekky
comments.body_html:
I don’t know your environment; however, this is the checklist I’ve gone through with others in your situation:

  • Ensure the firewall / router has TCP Ports 7828-7829 open for inbound traffic.
  • Ensure the host has TCP Ports 7828-7829 open for inbound traffic:
  • Current version requires a full game restart, if you modify the Server Address in the F12 menu to reconnect the WebSocket client with the server.
  • If running in a docker container, ensure docker container has ports TCP Ports 7828-7829 exposed to the host by ensuring the -p **7828-7829: 7828-7829** flag is used in addition to your other -p flags.
  • Unless you are using a proxy server in front of the SPT Server, all visits to the web client should be via: <address>:7829

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html:
Hey, these symptoms can’t come from Raid Review.

Search times and mag reloads are gameplay/inventory mechanics that Raid Review doesn’t patch. The mod only listens to events (kill, raid start/end, shot fired) in PostFix mode (read-only) and sends data over WebSocket. It never modifies items, magazines, or the in-game UI.

The actual culprit is probably a different mod that patches inventory/reload internals. I’d suggest checking your BepInEx/LogOutput.log for errors and trying to narrow it down. Cheers!

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html:
FYI, these symptoms (long search times, slow reloads) usually point to a RAM saturation issue, when the system runs out and starts paging to disk, EFT operations become extremely slow. Removing any mod can free up enough RAM to push the system back below the threshold.

I’d recommend checking your RAM usage during a raid. That’s probably your culprit. Cheers!
